title: Kinfold
tagline: A bright category card puzzle set in Egypt.
description: Match every card to its group and clear the board. Each card shows something from Egypt, and every category slot shows its name and its latest card.

howToPlay.title: Look at the cards
howToPlay.text: Each card shows something from Egypt. Spot what belongs together.

howToPlay.title: Drop them in groups
howToPlay.text: Place every card into its category slot. Each slot shows its name and latest card.

howToPlay.title: Clear the board
howToPlay.text: Finish every group to win the level and unlock the next one.

features: Egyptian themes, picture cards and bright, friendly art
Quick levels made for short breaks
